entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Eek!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: No one cares for true art... All they want[n]are easily recognizable brands!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I'm a victim in this too! Wouldn't you[n]agree!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Excuses now?

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: The art world revolves around money[n]after all... You can't rise up without[n]any money...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Yusuke, you understand, don't you!?[n]Being a poor artist is truly miserable!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I just didn't want to return to that life!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A fiend like you has no right to speak[n]about the world of art!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're done for—along with this whole[n]wretched world!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: *shriek* No, please! Just... don't kill me!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Return to yourself in reality and[n]confess your crimes—all of them!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Y-You're not going to kill me?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Swear it!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: *shriek* All right... All right!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Wh-What about the other one though?[n]The one with the black mask?
entries.uk: А-а як же той, другий? У чорній масці?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm?
Who?
Don't try to fool us.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I don't have any energy left to pull[n]such petty tricks...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A black mask?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, who's he talking about?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It can't be... There was another intruder[n]besides us within this Palace!?
entries.uk: Не може бути... У цьому Палаці, крім нас,[n]був ще один зловмисник!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no time! Hurry!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Get on!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't forget the Treasure!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Hey, Yusuke... What should I do?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Put an end to all this and use[n]your own artwork for once.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yusuke!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: No, wait! Please![n]Yusuke! Yusukeee!
